top_signals.title: Pacific Basin CEO Says Industry Faces Shift After Iran Conflict
top_signals.summary: Martin Fruergaard, CEO of Pacific Basin, says the shipping firm is prepared for further business disruptions later this year, backed by a pipeline of 25 vessels and strategic flexibility. He speaks exclusively on "Bloomberg: The China Show." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
